heroLead: Software services built around your needs.
heroBody: Tell us what you want to solve. We offer AI audits, automation, custom web apps, LLM integration and team training.
seniorBody: Senior developers handle your work directly.
businessBody: Save time, lower costs or grow revenue.
servicesTitle: What we can help you with
servicesBody: Each service has a clear deliverable. For a custom request, use the general enquiry form below.
workIntro: We designed, built and operate Studijo ourselves, from architecture to billing.
studioPreview: Generate text, images, video and voiceovers, add context from documents, and run other AI workflows in one place.
studioTools: Multiple models, a credit system, asynchronous jobs and integrations with external AI services.
studioDescription: An AI content studio that turns one brief into text, graphics, voiceovers, video, translations and courses. It combines several AI models, asynchronous processing and a credit system. We use the same building blocks in client projects.
trainingIntro: Learn to use AI tools hands-on with examples from everyday work.
aboutTitle: Work directly with the developer building your solution.
aboutIntro: Asterion Software is a small development studio specialising in backend systems, AI integrations and automation. On small and mid-sized projects, clients work directly with a senior developer.
aboutBody: This works particularly well when you need someone to understand the problem quickly and design a practical solution with minimal overhead.
diagramAlt: Diagram showing AI using documents, data, media and APIs to automate workflows, generate insights and trigger actions
faqIntro: Still have a question? Send us a message or call +420 604 257 866.
auditQuestion: How much does an AI audit cost?
auditAnswer: An AI audit starts at CZK 14,900 and takes one to two days. We review your processes, identify where AI or automation can save time or money, and provide a report with recommendations and next steps.
assistantQuestion: How much does an internal AI assistant for company documents cost?
assistantAnswer: A pilot starts at CZK 35,000. The final price depends mainly on the number and type of data sources, required integrations and access permissions. The assistant answers questions using your documentation and cites its sources.
processAnswer: We start with a short, no-obligation consultation to clarify your goals. We then propose a solution, a scope and a clear deliverable. After delivery, we can help with further implementation or work with you longer term.
contactQuestion: Who will I talk to during the project?
contactAnswer: You speak directly with the senior developer who designs and builds your solution, so questions can be resolved quickly and details stay clear.
excelQuestion: Can you turn our Excel spreadsheet into an app?
excelAnswer: Yes. We turn key spreadsheets and manual workflows into web apps with user accounts, permissions and change history. Projects typically start at CZK 45,000, depending on the data model and workflow.
trainingQuestion: Who is the corporate AI training for?
trainingAnswer: For employees who want to use AI in everyday work. We offer a three-hour AI Start course, a full-day Practical AI course based on your tasks, and an Automation Workshop for mapping processes.
ideaQuestion: Can I get in touch with just an idea?
ideaAnswer: Of course. Describe the situation in the form or give us a call. I’ll let you know whether we can help and suggest a next step.
contactTitle: Have a problem you’d like to discuss?
contactBody: Describe the situation in your own words. I’ll let you know whether we can help and suggest a next step.
deliverableGoal: a short initial consultation to clarify your goals,
deliverableFollowUp: the option to continue with implementation or long-term support.
